about: Criterion-8 exceptions, read by testkit/beta_readiness.py. One metric on one unpromised document, bounded, tied to the accepted sweep (by file name and SHA-256), the harness reading and the release it was decided for; each one an owner decision recorded in docs/beta-bar.md ('Exceptions') in the same commit. Out of bounds, or stale (another release, accepted sweep or reading), it blocks; once nothing needs it, it is reported as unused and deleted.

dy_p50.decided_by: the owner, by delegation to an independent decider (Fable 5.1), 2026-10-11
dy_p50.conditions: Second time y37's dy_p50 needed excusing (the first, WP33's split, was reverted unused after WP33n). Conditions a-f of the 2026-10-10 decision apply mutatis mutandis: like for like in the wp42 reading against this accepted sweep; y37 dy_p50 only, every other y37 metric gated at full tolerance, no other document; ceiling 33.0pt, above it blocking and a new decision; recorded in docs/beta-bar.md with this entry; dies with this accepted sweep, not carried to 0.3.0b2 or GA. d' on the FINAL renders (testkit/churn.py --check-y37 --current-sweep FINAL.sweep.json, render SHA-256s recorded): word_recall >= 0.37; common-word dy_p50 <= 1.1 x the accepted common; within2pt drop <= 0.05; LibreOffice out_pages < 27. Void if the ceiling or any d' bound is missed, y37 becomes promised, the accepted sweep/reading/release differ, a second document needs a dy_p50 waiver before the tag, or the owner revokes it before the tag. Amendment 4(e) -- a paired/common-word reading of criterion 8's dy_p50, designed with the owner -- is a pre-0.3.0b2 item.
